items.title: Covenant Health says May data breach impacted nearly 478,000 patients
items.description: The Covenant Health organization has revised to nearly 500,000 the number of individuals affected by a data breach discovered last May. [...]

items.title: Cryptocurrency theft attacks traced to 2022 LastPass breach
items.description: Blockchain investigation firm TRM Labs says ongoing cryptocurrency thefts have been traced to the 2022 LastPass breach, with attackers draining wallets years after encrypted vaults were stolen and laundering the crypto through Russian exchanges. [...]

items.title: Over 10K Fortinet firewalls exposed to actively exploited 2FA bypass
items.description: Over 10,000 Internet-exposed Fortinet firewalls are still vulnerable to attacks exploiting a five-year-old two-factor authentication (2FA) bypass vulnerability. [...]

items.title: Google is testing a new image AI and it's going to be its fastest model
items.description: Google is testing a new image AI model called "Nano Banana 2 Flash," and it's going to be as good as the Gemini 3 Pro Nano Banana, but it'll be cheaper. [...]

items.title: Trust Wallet links $8.5 million crypto theft to Shai-Hulud NPM attack
items.description: Trust Wallet believes the compromise of its web browser to steal roughly $8.5 million from over 2,500 crypto wallets is likely related to an "industry-wide" Sha1-Hulud attack in November. [...]
